set.pl: Lots 7-8, block 17, Torrent and Arms Plat, east side of Center St, North Muskegon. Parcel = NW half of lots 7-8, block 17, on Center St (1897 condemnation).
set.t: Urban lot. In June 1897, days after his death, a 60 ft county gravel road was cut across the lot. The house was moved to the lot corner and the road turns north in front of it, so the spot where he died lies under the road. Urban: look-only. Access: town lot.

src: Muskegon Chronicle 1897-06-19 p7, 07-28 p2, 08-11 p7, 08-30 p7; 1898-03-02 p4 (1897 road condemnation across the lot)
